# ChatJoinRequest

## Documentation

Represents a join request sent to a chat.

### Parameters

- **`chat`** ([`Chat`](Chat.md))
  Chat to which the request was sent.

- **`from_user`** ([`User`](User.md))
  User that sent the join request.

- **`date`** (`datetime`)
  Date the request was sent.

- **`bio`** (`str`, *optional*)
  Bio of the user.

- **`invite_link`** ([`ChatInviteLink`](ChatInviteLink.md), *optional*)
  Chat invite link that was used by the user to send the join request.

- **`query_id`** (`int`, *optional*)
  Identifier of the join request query, if the current bot is the guard bot of the chat.
  Use it with [`answer_chat_join_request_query`](../../methods/bots/answer_chat_join_request_query.md).
